briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: This hour, multiple sources reported on alleged child care fraud in Minnesota, including a viral video and federal investigations. The alleged fraud involves millions of dollars in child care funds and COVID relief money. I am concerned about the potential connections between these schemes and other entities or programs.
